mainEntity.name: How much does AI Search for contractors cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AI Search for contractors varies depending on several factors, including the scope of services, the competitiveness of your market, and the specific goals for your business. We offer customized packages designed to fit different budgets and needs. Typically, pricing is structured monthly or as a project-based fee, and includes initial setup, ongoing optimization, reporting, and support. A detailed proposal will be provided after an initial consultation to assess your unique requirements.
